texts.problem.slow-apex: {kmh} kilometers per hour too slow at the apex
texts.problem.fast-apex: {kmh} kilometers per hour too fast into the corner
texts.problem.brake-weak: too little brake pressure, {percent} instead of {refPercent} percent
texts.problem.brake-hard: too much brake pressure, {percent} instead of {refPercent} percent
texts.problem.no-trail: brake already off at turn-in, the reference still brakes with {refPercent} percent
texts.problem.trail-long: braked {meters} meters too far into the corner
texts.feedback.long: Heads up, the corner for feedback {number} is coming. What went wrong: {what}.
texts.feedback.guide: I'll take you through the corner: gear, brake and throttle.
texts.tip.no-brake: Brake here, a short press is enough.
texts.tip.wrong-gear-lower: Only shift down to {refGearWord} gear, not to {gearWord}.
texts.tip.brake-early: Wait until I say now. Don't brake at one.
texts.tip.brake-late: Brake right when I say now, not after it.
texts.tip.slow-apex: Brake less and carry more speed. Target: {refKmh} kilometers per hour at the apex.
texts.tip.fast-apex: Brake a little earlier or harder. Target: {refKmh} kilometers per hour at the apex.
texts.tip.late-throttle: Get on the throttle as soon as you unwind the steering.
texts.tip.no-trail: Stay on the brake with {refPercent} percent as you turn in and ease off towards the apex. That turns the car in.
texts.tip.trail-long: Ease off the brake from turn-in. At the apex it is fully off.
texts.tipTiny.brake-early: Brake only when I say now.
texts.help.long: Heads up, feedback {number}. Last time again {what}. Tip: {tip}
texts.help.focusStart: Little exercise: we focus only on {zone} now. For {lapsWord} laps I'll only talk there.
texts.help.focusStartOne: Little exercise: we focus only on {zone} now. For one lap I'll only talk there.
texts.help.focusEnd: Exercise over. All corners again from now on.
texts.help.focusDone: {zone} works now. Exercise done, well done.
texts.help.assist.wait: I'll say wait. Brake only when I say now.
texts.help.assist.early-now: This time I'll say now a little earlier.
texts.help.assist.target: I'll call the target speed at the apex.
texts.help.assist.throttle: I'll tell you when to get on the throttle.
texts.help.assist.trail: At turn-in I will say ease off, until then stay on the brake.
texts.help.assist.release: I will tell you when to come off the brake.
texts.briefing.introProblems: Briefing for {track}. {problemZones} of {zones} braking zones with mistakes.
texts.briefing.noProblems: Briefing for {track}. No mistakes last time. Keep it up.
texts.briefing.brake.full: Full braking at {speed} kilometers per hour
texts.briefing.brake.percent: Brake {percent} percent at {speed} kilometers per hour
texts.briefing.gears: Start in {entryWord} gear, out in {exitWord} gear
texts.briefing.gearsMid: Start in {entryWord} gear, then down to {midWord}, out in {exitWord} gear
texts.briefing.trailIntro: Trail braking means: stay on the brake as you turn in and ease off towards the apex. That turns the car in. I will tell you where the reference does it.
texts.briefing.trail: Still {percent} percent brake at turn-in, then ease off.
texts.briefing.end: End of briefing. Unpause when you are ready.
texts.plan.trail: Ease off the brake into the corner.
texts.curb.in.touch: one wheel on the inside curb
texts.curb.in.half: two wheels on the inside curb
texts.curb.in.full: all four on the inside curb
texts.curb.out.touch: one wheel on the outside curb
texts.curb.out.half: two wheels on the outside curb
texts.curb.out.full: all four on the outside curb
texts.after.slower: You were {kmh} kilometers per hour too slow out of the {corner}. Try: {tip}
texts.debrief.none: No mistakes remembered. Keep it up.
texts.debrief.end: Release the handbrake when you want to go on.
texts.debrief.hint: Tip: stop and pull the handbrake, and I will go through your {countWord} biggest mistakes.
texts.slide.cause.grass-throttle: You were on the throttle with wheels {surface}.
texts.slide.cause.curb-throttle: You were on the throttle on the curb.
texts.slide.cause.throttle: Too much throttle with the wheel still turned.
texts.slide.cause.brake: You braked too hard while turning in.
texts.slide.cause.lift: You lifted off the throttle abruptly in the corner.
texts.slide.pendulum: Then you held the counter-steer too long, and the rear swung the other way.
texts.slide.tip.grass-throttle: Off the track, lift off and keep the wheel straight. Only get back on the throttle on the tarmac.
texts.slide.tip.grass-brake: Off the track, do not brake hard, the wheels lock at once. Keep the wheel straight, slow down gently, then back onto the tarmac.
texts.slide.tip.grass: Off the track, stay calm and straight. Only turn again on the tarmac.
texts.slide.tip.curb-throttle: On the curb the rear wheels have little grip. Use only a little throttle there, full throttle on the tarmac.
texts.slide.tip.throttle: Squeeze the throttle gently, and go to full throttle only as you unwind the wheel.
texts.slide.tip.brake: Ease off the brake gradually as you turn in. That keeps the rear calm.
texts.slide.tip.brake-straight: Brake a little less hard, that keeps the rear calm.
texts.slide.tip.lift: Ease off the throttle gently in a corner, never abruptly.
texts.slide.tip.unknown: Then it was too much speed or too sudden steering. Steer in more smoothly.
texts.slide.tip.pendulum: Unwind the counter-steer as soon as the car catches itself.
cheeky.debriefBonus: And mistake number {number}: installing GT7. And then starting it.
Mistake number {number}: switching on the PlayStation. That is where it all began.
Bonus mistake: picking up the controller. Very brave.
Mistake number {number}: thinking braking was optional.
And mistake number {number}: switching me on. Now I have to watch all of this.
Mistake number {number}: picking this car. The car did nothing to deserve it.
Mistake number {number}: driving out onto the track. The track did not fight back.
Mistake number {number}: racing today instead of mowing the lawn. The lawn would have been happy.
cheeky.no-brake: No braking at all? Brave. Wrong, but brave.
The brake is the middle pedal. Just saying.
Through {zone} without braking. Interesting plan. It just does not work.
cheeky.brake-early: Braked too early again. The brake is not an anchor.
{zone} is not going anywhere. You can brake later.
Too early. Are you scared of that corner?
cheeky.brake-late: Late again. A braking point is not a braking suggestion.
Late, later, you. In {zone} that is not a compliment.
Late again. The gravel says hello.
cheeky.wrong-gear: Wrong gear. Again. The gearbox is crying.
Missed the gear again. Try counting along.
Shifting is an art. Not yours today.
cheeky.slow-apex: Too slow at the apex again. This is a race track, not a parking lot.
That slow through {zone}? I could make coffee meanwhile.
Too slow at the apex again. The car can do more. Honestly.
cheeky.fast-apex: Too fast in again. Physics does not negotiate.
Too fast. {zone} did not deserve that.
Brave on the way in, slow on the way out. Again.
cheeky.late-throttle: Late on the throttle again. The right pedal does not bite.
You are allowed to accelerate. Really.
Hesitating on the exit again. Waiting for an invitation?
cheeky.brake-weak: More brake pressure! The pedal is not an egg.
Too gentle on the brakes. Go on, commit.
cheeky.brake-hard: Less brake! You are braking, not parking.
Stamping on the brakes again. Feel helps more here.
cheeky.no-trail: Off the brake, then turn? In {zone} you can do both at once.
You drop the brake in {zone} like it is hot. It is not.
Turning in without brake in {zone}. The car pushes, and you wonder why.
cheeky.trail-long: On the brake all the way to the apex in {zone}. The corner is over, the braking is not.
In {zone} you are still braking while others are back on the throttle.
The brake in {zone} is allowed to let go. Honestly.
cheeky.level1: {zone}, {times} times the same mistake. I see a pattern.
Same mistake, same corner. At least you are consistent.
I have seen this before. {zone}, same as last lap.
cheeky.level2: What is the difference between you and my dog? My dog is deaf. That is why he does not listen to me.
I am taking a deep breath now. And you brake properly, please.
You know what insanity is? Doing the same thing and expecting a different result.
I told you. Several times. With feeling.
cheeky.level3: You have two pedals. One is throttle. One is brake. One of them you use too little.
Argh! I cannot watch anymore. Do whatever you want.
I am just a voice. But even I have feelings. And they are hurt.
You know what? I am telling the ghost. It will laugh itself silly.
Okay. Okay. All good. I am calm. I am totally calm. No, I am not!
I am calling the pit crew. They should get you out of there.
cheeky.relief: There you go! Told you so!
{zone}, clean! I knew you could do it. Almost.
See? That was not so hard.
cheeky.quit: I quit. I cannot watch this anymore. Find someone else!
That is it. I resign. For real this time. Bye!
You know what? Do it yourself. I am getting a coffee.
I am taking off the headset now. Good luck. You will need it.
cheeky.standIn: Hello, this is the stand-in. Your coach needs a break. I will take it from here.
Hi, I am the stand-in. They warned me about you. We will see.
Stand-in here. Your coach is crying in the pit box. We just keep driving.
cheeky.standInQuit: No. I am not paid enough for this. I am getting your coach back.
Okay, now I understand why your coach quit. Bye!
cheeky.comeback: Right. I am back. I have calmed down. Almost.
I am back. The stand-in says you are fine. I do not believe a word.
Coffee done, deep breath taken. On we go.
cheeky.comebackEarly: The stand-in quit too. Great. I am back.
I hear you scared off the stand-in. Impressive. I am back.
texts.crew.raceStart: Radio check. Your crew here. We will call after every sector.
texts.crew.sectorFaster: Sector {sectorWord}: {time} faster than your best lap.
texts.crew.sectorSlower: Sector {sectorWord}: {time} slower than your best lap.
texts.crew.sectorEven: Sector {sectorWord}: level with your best lap.
texts.crew.fuelLaps: Fuel for {laps} laps, {liters} liters per lap.
texts.crew.fuelPit: Box for fuel in lap {lap} at the latest.
texts.crew.tyresWear: Tyres are going off, {seconds} seconds a lap slower than fresh.
texts.crew.tyresPit: New tyres would pay off now.
texts.crew.tyresWithFuel: Take new tyres at the fuel stop.
texts.crew.tyresCold: Tyres still cold, careful into the next corner.
texts.crew.tyresWarm: Tyres are up to temperature, you can push.
texts.crew.tyresHotAll: Tyres are hot, take it a little easier.
texts.crew.tyresRising: Tyre temperature rising fast, {degrees} degrees now.
texts.crew.tyresFalling: Tyres cooling down fast, only {degrees} degrees.
cheeky.offtrack.level1: A little trip to the countryside?
Mowing the lawn is not on today's plan.
That was just off the track. Well, completely off.
The track is the grey bit with the white lines, by the way.
Nice view out there? We would rather see you on the tarmac.
A quick detour into the bushes. Noted.
We just got a report of grass in the radiator.
Little tip: the curbs are the limit, not the start.
cheeky.offtrack.level2: You know the grey stuff is the track, right?
The mechanic says thanks. He wanted to fit new brakes anyway.
Gravel again. Shall we bring you a shovel?
The marshals know you by your first name by now.
One more of those and we fit lawnmower tyres.
I stopped counting. No, I did not. That was number {times}.
The telemetry shows more grass than tarmac. That is not the plan.
You know what is faster than the gravel trap? Everything.
The pit wall asks if this is an off-road race now.
cheeky.offtrack.level3: Did you know there are drivers who at least pretend they can drive?
The team boss asks if we can return the car.
That was excursion number {times}. We will sell tickets soon.
I told the team we are going for the combine harvester bonus today.
I will say it very calmly: stay. On. The. Track.
The marshals have reserved you a regular seat in the gravel.
I have seen kids on ride-on toys hold a better line.
The car spent more time off the track than on it. Congratulations, not everyone manages that.
If this goes on, we will time your laps with a calendar.
I need a break soon. A long one.
cheeky.crewQuit: You know what? I am out. The team boss wants a word.
I am taking the headset off now. Have fun with the boss.
Right. Handing over to the team boss. He has more patience. Or so he says.
cheeky.bossIntro: This is the team boss. My race engineer needs a break. You need a track. Take the grey one.
Team boss here. From now on you talk to me. And we stay on the tarmac, understood?
The boss speaking. I am perfectly relaxed. For now.
cheeky.bossQuit: I am too old for this. I am getting the engineer back.
That is it, I have seen enough. The engineer takes over again.
cheeky.crewComeback: I am back. The boss says you behaved. More or less.
Back again. Rested and ready for clean laps. Hopefully you are too.
cheeky.crewComebackEarly: The boss gave up. I am back. Not by choice.
Guess who is back. The boss had enough.
texts.calibration.start: Calibration. Go full throttle on a straight. When I say now, you brake.
texts.calibration.done: Calibration done. You brake about {seconds} seconds after I say now. Apply the value in the app.
texts.session.playReplay: No reference yet. Play a ghost replay, or drive three laps and I will take your fastest.
texts.session.otherCar: Heads up, this car is different from the reference.
texts.session.referenceSwitched: Track recognized: {track}. Using the matching reference.
texts.session.learnOwn: No reference for this track and class yet. I will ride along quietly for {lapsWord} laps and take your fastest.
texts.session.otherCarNamed: Heads up, this car is different from the reference. Reference car: {car}.
